review:
Football-themed Hold the Jackpot on 9 reels in a stadium. It's the familiar Wazdan formula with sporty names: Cash Infinity symbols are worth more and stick until the end of the next bonus.

The Penalty Kick label attaches to a reel and pays a prize when its countdown hits zero. xG Chance Level is the usual bet multiplier with a football name, making the bonus more likely. High volatility, 2,500x max, 96.04% RTP. Straightforward fun for football fans.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
